brief.symptoms: The consumer group test panics with a nil pointer dereference when the context is canceled before the session can be created.
brief.evidence:
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
FAIL	github.com/IBM/sarama	0.093s
hints: The consumer group attempts to start a new session even after the caller has canceled the operation.
Look at the consumer-group package - the retry loop does not check the context early enough.
When the context is canceled, the retry path should abort immediately and return the canceled error.
brief.lesson: A consumer group must abort its session creation as soon as the supplied context signals Done, otherwise downstream code dereferences a nil coordinator and panics.
